WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
        r.name AS region,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN regions r
        ON r.region_id = c.region_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-07-31'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
), revenue_with_lag AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        region,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY month) AS previous_month_revenue
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
    month,
    region,
    revenue,
    previous_month_revenue,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_month_revenue)
        / NULLIF(previous_month_revenue, 0),
        2
    ) AS month_over_month_change_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN ROUND(
            100.0 * (revenue - previous_month_revenue)
            / NULLIF(previous_month_revenue, 0),
            2
        ) < -25.0 THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS unusual_decline
FROM revenue_with_lag
WHERE month >= DATE '2026-02-01'
  AND month <= DATE '2026-07-31'
ORDER BY region, month
LIMIT 500;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-07-31' GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, revenue FROM monthly_revenue WHERE month >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND month < DATE '2026-08-01' ORDER BY month LIMIT 500;

WITH completed_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31'
), product_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.name AS product_name,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN completed_orders co
      ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN products p
      ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    total_revenue
FROM product_revenue
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, product_id
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category
LIMIT 500;

WITH completed_order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
        r.name AS region,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN regions r
        ON r.region_id = c.region_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-02-01'
      AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-07-31'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
), targets AS (
    SELECT
        mt.month,
        r.name AS region,
        mt.revenue_target
    FROM monthly_targets mt
    JOIN regions r
        ON r.region_id = mt.region_id
    WHERE mt.month >= DATE '2026-02-01'
      AND mt.month <= DATE '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT
    t.month,
    t.region,
    COALESCE(cor.revenue, 0) AS revenue,
    t.revenue_target,
    COALESCE(cor.revenue, 0) - t.revenue_target AS target_variance,
    ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(cor.revenue, 0) / NULLIF(t.revenue_target, 0), 2) AS target_achievement_pct
FROM targets t
LEFT JOIN completed_order_revenue cor
    ON cor.month = t.month
   AND cor.region = t.region
ORDER BY t.month, t.region
LIMIT 500;

WITH region_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        c.region_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-08-01'
    GROUP BY c.region_id
)
SELECT
    r.name AS region,
    rr.revenue AS revenue,
    mt.revenue_target AS revenue_target,
    rr.revenue - mt.revenue_target AS target_variance
FROM region_revenue rr
JOIN monthly_targets mt
    ON mt.region_id = rr.region_id
   AND mt.month = DATE '2026-07-01'
JOIN regions r
    ON r.region_id = rr.region_id
WHERE rr.revenue < mt.revenue_target
ORDER BY target_variance ASC, region ASC
LIMIT 500;

SELECT c.segment AS segment, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-02-01'
  AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-07-31'
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY c.segment
LIMIT 500;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
        c.segment AS segment,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-08-01'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
), monthly_with_lag AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        segment,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY segment
            ORDER BY month
        ) AS previous_month_revenue
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
    month,
    segment,
    revenue,
    previous_month_revenue,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_month_revenue) / NULLIF(previous_month_revenue, 0),
        2
    ) AS growth_pct
FROM monthly_with_lag
WHERE month >= DATE '2026-02-01'
  AND month < DATE '2026-08-01'
ORDER BY month, segment
LIMIT 500;

SELECT
  date_trunc('month', order_date)::date AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_orders,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS cancellation_rate_pct
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-02-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-08-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 500

WITH customer_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.name AS customer_name,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o
        ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    total_revenue
FROM customer_revenue
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_id
LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_orders, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS average_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-07-31' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY r.name LIMIT 500

WITH category_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.category AS category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi
        ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p
        ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-02-01'
      AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-07-31'
    GROUP BY p.category
), total_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_revenue) AS grand_total_revenue
    FROM category_revenue
)
SELECT
    cr.category,
    cr.total_revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * cr.total_revenue / NULLIF(tr.grand_total_revenue, 0), 2) AS contribution_pct
FROM category_revenue cr
CROSS JOIN total_revenue tr
ORDER BY cr.total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 500;
